headline: Western Australia Becomes First State to Legalise Balcony Solar Systems
summary: Western Australia will permit plug-in balcony solar panels and batteries, making it the first Australian state to legalize the distributed residential technology.
why: Balcony solar allows apartment dwellers to generate green electricity, impacting grid loads and decentralized power markets.

impacts.name: Rooftop Solar
impacts.why: Opening urban multi-family housing to plug-in solar hardware accelerates equipment distributor sales.
